in_hebrew.name: Thedrick
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God's rule, power
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Thedrick הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Theo- (God) and drick (rule, power). In Greek mythology, Thedoros was a name for a god of fertility and growth. In the Christian context, Thedric or Thedrick is a name for a person who aspires to God's rule and power in their life.

In Greek mythology, Thedoros was a name for a god of fertility and growth. In the Christian context, Thedric or Thedrick is a name for a person who aspires to God's rule and power in their life.
